entries.title: 小组汇报
entries.content:
Please divide the 29 students into 8 groups (3 to 4 students per group). In each class, 2 groups will each deliver a 10-minute mini speech on the reading materials to present their understanding of the materials (every student must speak, with a 10-minute time limit for each group).
Specific requirements for the mini speech:
1. Present a clear viewpoint; 2. Provide supporting evidence.
